elements.label: About
elements.value: Manages IsGrounded, IsJumping, and IsRecentlyGrounded animator variables for jump and landing transitions.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/airborne_states.schema.json, set as_c_grounded to {{as_c_grounded}}]
Set landing sensitivity to {{as_c_grounded}} by adjusting groundedThreshold. Tight=0.3, Standard=0.8, Generous=1.5.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/airborne_states.schema.json, set as_t_threshold to {{as_t_threshold}}]
Set AnimationController.groundedThreshold to {{as_t_threshold}}.
